name: cyrius-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for the Cyrius language toolchain — currently the cyrius-lsp language-server wiring; future Cyrius-related Claude Code extensions land here. Sibling repo to MacCracken/cyrius (the language).

plugins.name: cyrius-lsp
plugins.description: Cyrius language server (cyrius-lsp) wired to every .cyr-family extension (.cyr / .tcyr / .bcyr / .fcyr / .scyr / .smcyr): diagnostics from cycc through the cyrius CLI, hover, go-to-definition, references, document symbols and semantic tokens; a launcher finds the server when ~/.cyrius/bin is not on PATH.
